subject: Animation
title: Research Trips: Living the Story
description: A short lesson to help you apply Research Trips: Living the Story.

hook.text: Before making a Pixar film, the team goes on research trips to live inside the story's world.

buildup.text: For Up, artists traveled to Venezuela's tepui mountains. For Coco, they visited Mexican villages.

discovery.text: The trips give animators details no reference photo can provide — smells, sounds, and feelings.

twist.text: For Finding Nemo, the entire team got scuba certified. For Ratatouille, they ate at fine Paris restaurants.

climax.text: These research trips are expensive, but Pixar considers them essential for authentic storytelling.

punchline.text: Pixar animates what it has touched, tasted, and breathed.

quiz.question: Why does Pixar send teams on research trips?
options: To experience the story's world firsthand and capture authentic sensory details
To scout filming locations for live-action versions
